cases.name: heart-rate-instant
cases.note: The spec's sample (fhir-data-model.md), plus meta.source.

cases.name: heart-rate-period
cases.note: start != end gives effectivePeriod.

cases.name: heart-rate-fractional-seconds
cases.note: A non-zero sub-second part is kept to 3 digits.

cases.name: heart-rate-decimal-value
cases.note: A non-integer value is kept.

cases.name: heart-rate-no-device
cases.note: Without a device reference there is no device element.

cases.name: heart-rate-healthkit-uuid-lowercased
cases.note: HealthKit identity: healthkit-sample system, lowercase UUID, healthkit meta.source.

cases.name: heart-rate-healthkit-user-entered
cases.note: Typed in by hand in Apple Health: stored as given, tagged user-entered; a hand entry has no device.

cases.name: heart-rate-artifact-above-range
cases.note: An implausible spike is stored as given and tagged artifact-suspected.

cases.name: heart-rate-late-arrival
cases.note: Received long after it was measured: tagged late-arrival.

cases.name: heart-rate-duplicate-resolved
cases.note: Two deliveries met in the queue before upload: one Observation, tagged duplicate-resolved.

cases.name: heart-rate-all-flags-sorted
cases.note: Every flag at once: tags in ascending code order, and the value untouched.

cases.name: hrv-sdnn-artifact-below-range
cases.note: HRV below its range: tagged.

cases.name: dietary-energy-with-meal
cases.note: Energy, LOINC 9052-2, UCUM kcal, domain nutrition plus a separate lunch entry.

cases.name: dietary-protein
cases.note: Protein, LOINC 9079-5 'Estimated', grams.

cases.name: dietary-carbohydrates
cases.note: Carbohydrate, LOINC 9059-7.

cases.name: dietary-fat
cases.note: Total fat, LOINC 9066-2.

cases.name: dietary-water
cases.note: Water maps to LOINC 8984-7 Fluid intake, in mL.

cases.name: dietary-fiber-custom-code
cases.note: Fiber has no per-entry LOINC code: the project's nutrient system, code in text.

cases.name: dietary-sugar-custom-code
cases.note: Sugar, custom code.

cases.name: dietary-sodium-custom-code-mg
cases.note: Sodium stays in mg under the custom code (no mmol conversion).

cases.name: dietary-sodium-zero-is-stored
cases.note: Zero is a valid intake (a food with no sodium): stored as given, never refused.

cases.name: dietary-energy-zero-is-stored
cases.note: Zero energy (water, black coffee): stored.

cases.name: dietary-energy-no-meal-has-one-category
cases.note: No meal label: one category entry, never an invented meal.

cases.name: dietary-energy-meal-other-keeps-label
cases.note: An unknown meal name is the code other and keeps its label in text.

cases.name: dietary-energy-artifact
cases.note: A figure no single entry could carry is stored as given and tagged artifact-suspected.

cases.name: dietary-energy-all-flags-sorted
cases.note: Every flag with a meal: tags in ascending code order, value untouched.

cases.name: resting-heart-rate-day-period
cases.note: Resting HR over a local day: LOINC 40443-4 and a period.

cases.name: hrv-sdnn-instant
cases.note: HRV SDNN: LOINC 112429-6, UCUM ms.

cases.name: heart-rate-utc-zone-is-plus-zero-not-Z
cases.note: A UTC sample carries +00:00, never Z.

cases.name: heart-rate-half-hour-offset
cases.note: Asia/Kolkata is +05:30.

cases.name: heart-rate-negative-half-hour-dst
cases.note: America/St_Johns in July is -02:30 (daylight time).

cases.name: heart-rate-period-across-spring-forward
cases.note: Start in PST (-08:00), end in PDT (-07:00): each end has its own offset.

cases.name: heart-rate-fall-back-first-1:30
cases.note: 01:30 local on 2026-11-01 occurs twice; this is the first (PDT, -07:00).

cases.name: heart-rate-fall-back-second-1:30
cases.note: ...and this is the second (PST, -08:00): same wall clock, different instant.
